T0589.title: Connected-Vehicle API
T0589.definition: An API that exposes vehicle status, location, remote-control, diagnostics, or service capabilities.
T0589.description: Connected-vehicle APIs expose vehicle status, location, remote control, diagnostics, and service features across mobile apps, cloud platforms, and vehicles. Risks include unauthorized queries, remote-control abuse, location leakage, and overprivileged third-party integrations. Controls focus on object-level authorization, command risk checks, device binding, and traceability.
T0589.usageExample: Assess Connected-Vehicle API related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
